thread:
ana: quick, we need a press-ready sanity run for the upcoming launch + webinar. checklist: conservative headline numbers (p95/p99 token latency), coldstart heatmap, and a long-context tail probe for quantized-n4. emphasize reproducibility and a short methodology blurb we can paste.

sam: got it. which region and artifacts should we publish?

ana: region us-central-1. artifacts: latencies.csv (token-level), heatmap.png, samples.json (12 samples total, 4 per prompt), run manifest with exact model revision + seeds + CLI snippet. no KV cache dumps. s3 path: s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/2965432101-press-ready/.

leo: traffic profile and warmup guidance? any buckets you want?

ana: measurement profile: 48 qps sustained for 8 minutes. include two warmup regimes labeled in the CSV: warmup=120s (conservative) and warmup=30s (short) so we can show warmup sensitivity. induce 3 coldstarts in measurement by restarting workers. run float16 baseline back-to-back for delta.

maria: I need a one-paragraph method blurb and a one-line CSV header for the slides. tag dataset id and include sample->seed mapping in the manifest.

sam: plan: staging cluster, seeds [2,17,409], run order: quantized-n4 (30s warmup -> meas 8m) then quantized-n4 (120s warmup -> meas 8m) then float16 baseline (120s warmup -> meas 8m). record token latencies + GPU util (lightweight). CLI snippet will be embedded in the manifest for docs. estimated upload ~35-50m.

leo: note: quantized-n4 has shown tail sensitivity under short warmup; including both buckets is helpful. coldstarts scheduled at minute 2, 4, and 6 of each measurement window.

benchbot: Scheduled bench job rb-2965432101 on staging for 2024-10-02T04:00:00Z. ETA artifacts: ~45m after completion.

sam: running now. will avoid KV dumps to keep artifacts small. adding reproducible snippet for the manifest.

ana: include an explicit flag in the manifest: "public_headline_bucket=warmup=120s" so marketing can pick the conservative numbers for press. also include whether samples are deterministic with seed mapping.

benchbot: rb-2965432101 COMPLETE. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/2965432101-press-ready/{manifest.txt,latencies.csv,heatmap.png,samples.json,gpu-util.csv}.

benchbot: Summary (measurement windows):
- quantized-n4 (30s warmup): p95=88ms p99=275ms; coldstart first-token spike median ~1.02s.
- quantized-n4 (120s warmup): p95=74ms p99=195ms; coldstart first-token spike median ~0.65s.
- float16 baseline (120s warmup): p95=69ms p99=165ms.

maria: grabbing artifacts and drafting the methodology blurb. quick note: quantized-n4 p99 (120s) is +9% vs last-public 120s baseline; that's within threshold. short-warmup bucket shows the warmup sensitivity we should call out in the appendix.

sam: diff check: short-warmup p99 is higher than our last run by 28% due to a sequencing change in staging warmup order; I recommend we keep the public headline as 120s numbers. if marketing insists on short-warmup numbers in headline, I can rerun with longer warmup but that delays artifacts.

ana: we will use the 120s bucket for headlines and include the 30s numbers in the appendix to show sensitivity. maria: please paste this one-paragraph method blurb into the blog: "All runs executed on staging (us-central-1) with seeds [2,17,409]. We measured two warmup regimes (30s and 120s) to illustrate warmup sensitivity. Per-request latencies were recorded at token granularity; artifacts include latencies.csv, heatmap.png, samples.json, and a run manifest with the exact model revision hash and CLI used for reproducibility."

maria: will do. also adding a one-line CSV header for slides: "ts,request_id,seed,model,variant,warmup_sec,qps,latency_ms,token_idx".

leo: reproducible CLI snippet for manifest (pasteable):
```
bench-run --model redwood/quantized-n4:rev-20241002-abc123 --region us-central-1 --qps 48 --warmup 30 --duration 480 --seeds 2,17,409 --out s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/2965432101-press-ready/30s/
bench-run --model redwood/quantized-n4:rev-20241002-abc123 --region us-central-1 --qps 48 --warmup 120 --duration 480 --seeds 2,17,409 --out s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/2965432101-press-ready/120s/
bench-run --model redwood/float16:rev-20241002-def456 --region us-central-1 --qps 48 --warmup 120 --duration 480 --seeds 2,17,409 --out s3://redwood-launch-artifacts/2965432101-press-ready/float16/
```

benchkbot: (note: artefact sizes kept small; KV dumps excluded).

ana: perfect. flag any p99 >20% vs last-public as a regression. Sam, since short-warmup delta is large, annotate staging sequence notes in manifest. marketing will publish with the 120s numbers and an appendix calling out warmup sensitivity. thanks team :tada:
